recentDialogue.quotedText: さっき見たプロジェクターの位置を覚えている？今は動かず、覚えていることを教えて。
今天想聊音乐，不需要动作。
这次搜索还没有确认整个目标或观察任务完成，不能仅凭看过的范围说目标不存在。

currentFacts.scope: Current engine observations for the explicit user's target revision. assessment describes user approach, not a scene-object destination. executionTargetKind identifies the running/last task. no-attempt means no user approach has been submitted for this target; assessment is not an action result.

assessment.reason: 当前几何路线可规划；尚未执行，生成时长与服务检查仍待实际请求验证。
assessment.scope: User-approach geometry only. This does not assess a visible object or in-place observation. Generation duration, service capability, pose history and playback have not been validated; reachable does not mean movement executed or guaranteed.

observation.summary: 本次仅检查 24 个候选站位：可用 11，起点检查拒绝 0，终点检查拒绝 13，途中检查拒绝 0，用户身体间距拒绝 0，其他拒绝 0。这是本次有限搜索结果，不能据此断定所有路线都被某件家具挡住。

lastActionResults.scope: Historical result of the last actual room approach; targetKind distinguishes user and scene-object. Do not reuse its rejection for a different target. currentFacts.assessment checks only user approach; lastSceneTargetResult describes the actual object approach.

lastSceneTargetResult.scope: Actual scene-object floor movement result; motionKind distinguishes approach from an explicit relative observation offset. Reached refers only to the validated floor station and facing; it does not prove semantic object identity, touching, a fresh view, or better visibility. User proximity is unrelated to this goal.

scope: currentFacts.assessment and currentSupport concern approach/follow of the explicit USER only. A user's unsupported camera position does not by itself make object approach or looking unavailable. userTrackingValid and userSupportVerified are separate. sceneActionFacts/lastSceneTargetResult describe scene actions. lastActionResults and execution retain targetKind and action identity; never reuse a result for another goal.

visualObservation.scope: RGB rendered from the character head view at capture time. No inferred object names, depth, reachability or current-visibility guarantee.

lastAction.reason: actual view changed and a new image was acquired; decide from these pixels, not assumed unseen contents

viewBefore.scope: Measured visible opaque pixels only, top-left image origin. Bounds may be clipped by occlusion; no edge contact does not prove full visibility or readable text. Compare the new RGB against the requested purpose.

viewAfter.scope: Measured visible opaque pixels only, top-left image origin. Bounds may be clipped by occlusion; no edge contact does not prove full visibility or readable text. Compare the new RGB against the requested purpose.

lastAction.scope: Purpose is the model's intention, not a claim about unseen space. Angles are relative requests; only actual head/body motion and a new image establish a changed view. No root teleport, object identity or arrival is implied.

runtimeDeviceControl.supportedOperation: set-object-state:on|off for an explicitly registered lamp
runtimeDeviceControl.scope: Software capability facts, not target identity, current visibility, permission or proof of execution. A missing goal approval or unresolved target does not remove this interface. Lack of physical switch-touching does not prevent this registered runtime lamp control.

selected.scope: opaque surface visible in this captured frame; world point is a capture-time snapshot, not current position or reachability

runtimeDeviceStateReadAfterObservation.scope: Runtime device state for the bound visible emissive element and Light component only. Baked illumination may remain and is not controlled. This is not a physical hand press, scene-wide darkness or a fresh visual observation.

localStructure.source: engine-registered-local-structure; not an inference from image or proof that every part is visible
localStructure.relation: parts-of-selected-entity; does not mean resting-on furniture

stateResult.reason: 已关闭登记灯具的可见发光体及 Light 组件；未移除烘焙余光。

actual.scope: Runtime device state for the bound visible emissive element and Light component only. Baked illumination may remain and is not controlled. This is not a physical hand press, scene-wide darkness or a fresh visual observation.

stateResult.scope: Whitelist device action: set the registered lamp's visible emission and Light component power. Original material assets and baked lighting are unchanged; visual confirmation must be obtained separately.

targetReview.modelReason: Controlled independent current pixels confirm the complete requested same-entity target.
targetReview.proposalScope: A nonmatched proposal is only a cue for the next fresh-image decision, not a semantic match or permission for this action. At most one candidate-match request is made by this action; never retry stale pixels automatically.
targetReview.scope: Model interpretation of this exact candidate image, separate from engine identity. A reference selected for observe-closer is not confirmation of the original small target. When uncertain, consider a visible larger reference and targetPurpose=observe-closer in a NEW approach decision, then reobserve and retry the original goal; no automatic device operation. User correction can revoke a referent association without deleting objective seen-object history.
targetReview.associationScope: Historical target review from another user turn; re-evaluate the present referent.

objectContext.deviceEvidenceScope: Engine result-validity check only; false invalidates prior device state claims. No new device setting or visual observation is supplied here; inspect again to establish current facts.
objectContext.rejectionCauseScope: Pixel/identity resolution failure does not establish which intended object was selected. Missing registered power capability concerns only the resolved entity and this software interface. Neither finding diagnoses electricity, cables, outlets, broken hardware or whether the intended lamp is a nonfunctional ornament. A different selected entity does not erase the prior device's successful operation.
objectContext.scope: Only previously selected visible entities, observed timestamps and explicit device results. These are snapshots, not continuous perception or a room inventory. Scene-authored labels are annotations, not visual recognition. Hierarchy does not prove support/contact. No arbitrary Inspector edits or physical hand interaction. On/off controls the registered emitter and Light flag; baked lighting may remain.

sceneActionFacts.capability: look-at or approach-object using captureId plus normalized visible image point; reposition-view uses a freshly confirmed entity to adjust the same-floor observation station farther/closer/left/right by 0.2 to 1.2 metres while facing that target. see-whole/read-detail/avoid-occlusion are observation purposes, not promised outcomes; assess the new image after movement. orient-view changes real head direction without needing an already visible target; turn-in-place turns the actual body on its current legal floor. Bounded historical snapshots may be acquired during an actual body turn; a new current view is still captured after completion. No stairs or touching. When objectContext.enabled, inspect-object resolves only the selected visible entity; set-object-state on/off requires its explicit registered nearby device capability and fresh confirmation. look-at can focus an unresolved image region without claiming a measured object. Autonomous view changes bounded to three per 30 seconds.

visibleKnownObjects.scope: Same previously identified entity confirmed visible in this captured frame. Copy entityTarget for reference; execution still requires a new physical-view confirmation. No new device-state read or capability grant.

sceneActionPrerequisites.scope: Only previously observed entities are checked against this exact fresh frame. Not-confirmed means no usable current opaque-pixel confirmation, not absence from the room or from every image candidate. Do not assume historical IDs are currently visible. Current registered-device distances use the same avatar-root to device-root metric as the final operation gate; outside range makes a direct write premature. Choose a useful legal approach/view change or clarification as appropriate. Another visible candidate may be independently matched. These facts do not identify the user's target, grant authority, prove a route, read device state or replace fresh semantic/capability/owner/distance checks.

objects.scope: Previously confirmed opaque pixels and their exact capture-time geometry/view. Root snapshot is recorded only while captured renderer geometry still matches. Historical location is a search hint, never current visibility, a navigation destination, device state or action permission.

relativeToCurrentView.scope: Camera-relative bearing to frozen historical pixels, not current visibility, current object position, reachability or permission.

relativeToCurrentBody.scope: Body-relative bearing to the same frozen historical point, measured at current capture time. Distinct from head/camera bearing; never a route or action authorization.

selfPose.scope: Measured body and head-camera poses from the same render as this current image. Signed yaw is positive right, elevation positive up. Relative movement compares only these measured poses, never an inferred action, route or unseen object movement.

decisionContractFacts.evidenceSource: For a reviewed standing-goal step currentUserText is its original approved request; latestUserText is separately reviewed dialogue/update. For a new goal only actual currentUserText supplies new authorization. Historical receipts resolve identity, never authorize a device write.
decisionContractFacts.goalReferenceRule: No listed goal means omit observationGoalId. An already identified object can be approached by entityTarget without an observation goal. Entity IDs, action IDs and capture IDs never substitute for goal IDs.
decisionContractFacts.turnRule: Turn around uses turn-in-place, never a 180 degree neck turn. Return a new complete decision; the runtime does not clamp or rewrite an invalid action.
decisionContractFacts.currentRequestOnlyRule: Plan only currentUserText, the complete actual latest user request. standingGoal and pendingDeviceRequest are background context, not action authority. Their quoted target description may explain what the user now wants to look for; an earlier review rejection is not a user cancellation. Do not resume the old device operation or output deviceGoal (including cancel) or set-object-state. A currently requested independent search, turn, look, inspection, observation approach, user movement or stop remains available under normal evidence checks. If latestGoalUpdate.cancellationApplied=true, cancellation is already applied: handle any remaining action in the SAME user sentence without asking to cancel again. Choose none when no independent action is requested. These limits also apply to decision repair.

sceneTime.poseThresholds: root translation 1 cm; head direction 2 degrees; breathing below thresholds is not a new activity

scenePlaybackReview.scope: One budgeted scene-action review can overlap only the final generated local speech clip. It cannot speak, execute tools, mutate work/memory, or claim unheard speech was delivered. Any next action still requires normal current-view decision and execution checks.

lastFailedAttempt.reason: object-target-expired: Candidate view needs a fresh observation from the same active character view and binding.
